mechanism_narrative: The continued decline in WORKPLACES mobility signals weaker commuting and daytime trip chaining, which reduces discretionary shopping visits and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four weeks after a further two-week drop in WORKPLACES, or rises instead while WORKPLACES remains below -10.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in PARKS mobility below its recent average indicates a broad pullback in discretionary out-of-home activity, and that same demand shock will spill into retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -15 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the week after PARKS stays below -15, or RETAIL_REC improves while PARKS remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays positive while TRANSIT remains depressed, households are substituting toward local essential trips and away from discretionary cross-town shopping, which keeps RETAIL_REC on a downward path over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above 0 and TRANSIT staying below -10.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls past a deep-disruption threshold, access to retail corridors deteriorates and retail-and-recreation mobility drops further over the next four weeks as trip networks re-route or cancel.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -18 in a weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline after TRANSIT crosses below -18, or it rebounds while TRANSIT remains below -18.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in WORKPLACES marks a stay-at-home substitution pattern that suppresses shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks even though RESIDENTIAL stays above 3 and WORKPLACES stays below -10.

mechanism_narrative: An upward swing in PARKS mobility while WORKPLACES remains weak indicates weather- or calendar-driven discretionary outings that first lift recreation and then support retail visits within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS reverses upward by at least 10 points from a recent weekly low
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains lower than the prior four weeks after PARKS rebounds by at least 10 points, especially if WORKPLACES stays below -10.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a sustained improvement in TRANSIT combined with recovering WORKPLACES signals eased access to city centers, which should raise RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within two weeks after TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise by at least 3 points from their recent weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: A further weakening in GROCERY_PHARM after already low TRANSIT indicates reduced errand density and fewer combined shopping trips, which will pull RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0 while TRANSIT remains below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over four weeks after GROCERY_PHARM turns negative while TRANSIT stays below -15.
